title: I have not been able to log in and operate my personal email on Earthlink.com for about the last 6 months using my MacBook Air
creator: olsoncna
content:
I have not been able to log in and operate my personal email on Earthlink.com for about the last 6 months using my MacBook Air. It refuses to accept my many valid attempts over the months to update the email password. To overcome this difficulty, I have updated all 140.12.1esr (aarch64) involved software, still to no benefit. My wife on her MacBook Air has been routinely checking my Earthlink email as she and I (on my MacBook) have been able to do with Thunderbird for over 20 years. I find this very frustrating and tiring. 

  I hope some of you out there have a working solution for me.  It will really uplift my life !

- Alan Olson in Lebanon PA
